name: Azure Web Application Firewall
short_description: Azure security service (WAF) that inspects web requests and blocks common attacks such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting; it can run on Azure Application Gateway or Azure Front Door in detection or prevention mode.

evidence.quote: WAF V2 adds the protection that blocks attacks.
Azure Web Application Firewall is not the firewall you are picturing.
Application gateway gives you layer 7 routing and a web application firewall.
every PowerPages site comes with a web application firewall or WAF.
Security at the edge, the WAF and beyond. So now let's talk about security. Because Front Door sits at the very edge
